DECL	{"assumptions":[],"binders":["v"],"id":"NRS_484B_400_2a","intentions":["int.left_turn"],"laws":["NRS-484B-400-2a"],"narrowings":[{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"'that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof' is written, where the carrier is a recorded lane, as the lane with no neighbouring lane of its own direction on its left: st.lane_adjacency counts ordinals from the left looking along the lane's designated direction, so the leftmost lane of that direction is the record's ordinal 1, and the relation states it without a magnitude of this file's own."},{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"'where the carriageway carries no recorded lane' is written as the approach carrier the subject occupies not being a recorded lane (st.lane): the duty is read carrier by carrier, so the centre-line reading applies exactly at a carrier whose lanes the source does not record."},{"kind":"reading","span":"ob1","why":"'The approach for a left turn must be made in' is read at every carrier the subject occupies whose entrance end is that junction, not at one of them: where it occupies several, no carrier that favours the subject is picked."}],"operationalizations":[],"residues":[],"surrogate":false}
